sources.claim: EN-3 2025 came into force 6 January 2026; renewable-energy NSIP policy, assessment and mitigation framework.
EN-5 2025 came into force 6 January 2026; electricity-network NSIP policy, assessment and mitigation framework.
NPS review table records EN-3 and EN-5 update 6 January 2026, NNNPS update 24 May 2024 and other sector review/status dates.
NNNPS designated 24 May 2024; examination acceptance date controls 2015 versus 2024 NPS applicability.
RIS3 is the strategic-road investment and management strategy for April 2026 to March 2031.
National Highways performance report published 16 July 2026 covers 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
Wind-turbine noise guidance published 19 June 2026 replaces the 1996 ETSU-R-97 document for planning-context noise assessment.
Planning Data transport-access-node mirror reports collector 26 July 2026 and new data 25 July 2026; origin remains MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
Development-plan-document dataset reports collector 26 July 2026, new data 10 February 2026 and MHCLG-created origin pending authoritative replacement.
Approved planning-data standard relates to Planning Data (England) Regulations 2026; commencement 7 May 2026 and applies to local/minerals/waste plan timetables and local-plan housing requirement.
Local, minerals and waste planning authorities must create, publish and keep plan timetables up to date.
Mineral extraction requires planning permission plus relevant permits/approvals; safeguarding protects resources but is not extraction consent.
HMLR Practice Guide 65 was updated 1 June 2026 for digital application practice; it is registration procedure guidance, not general minerals law or planning consent.
New local plan-making system in force from 25 March 2026; guidance includes minerals and waste plan transition.
Section 62A page last updated 15 June 2026; county-matter minerals and waste development is outside the eligible application types described.
EA voluntary remediation advice published 3 June 2026 is restricted to sites where contamination has impacted controlled waters and has defined scope exclusions.
Contaminated-land and groundwater generic developed principles updated 30 March 2026; regulatory principles are not parcel planning clearance.
On 6 July 2026 government laid final proposed amended Ports NPS text for a 21-sitting-day consideration period; treated as proposed/parliamentary-stage, not silently as designated.
HS2 safeguarded-area dataset currently reports 0 rows, 0 providers and no collector attempt; zero coverage is fail-closed and not evidence of no safeguarding.

promotion_policy: No strategy, NPS, plan timetable, dataset mirror, registration procedure, remediation guidance or zero-coverage dataset is promoted to exact parcel/site permission without exact current site evidence.
